subject: Exec QBR snapshot — launch readiness thermometer & asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: pq-support@redwood-partner.com
Date: Sat, 04 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Exec QBR snapshot — launch readiness thermometer & asks

Team —

Preparing the QBR packet and wanted to circulate a tight operational snapshot for the leadership table this afternoon. Attached is a one-sheet (launch-readiness-thermometer.xlsx) I built from product + eng inputs; summary below. Please skim and reply with any edits or blockers by 12:30p PT so I can fold into the exec pack.

Top-line (3-minute read):
- Launch window: Targeting Sept 18 GA for Orion pilot (same as runway discussed).
- Current sentiment (thermometer): Amber — at-risk areas in infra scaling and integrations.
- Major delivery risks: multi-region failover tests incomplete; integration contract boundary with Orion data ingestion; two critical bug fixes in model-serving path (KV cache invalidation, OOM on long contexts).

Immediate asks (actionable):
1) Vivek — confirm whether we can shift a spare 2 x A100 capacity from non-production to the Orion pool for end-to-end failover testing this week. If not, I need a fallback plan.
2) Monica — please confirm CS/PM alignment on the go/no-go criteria doc (last tab in the sheet). Need sign-off or explicit open items.
3) Marissa — pricing/terms note: Orion expects an SLO conversation in the QBR; can you surface the proposed SLA tiers and any concession ask?

Attachments: launch-readiness-thermometer.xlsx (sheet with heatmap + owners), orion-risk-register.pdf (condensed), demo-screencast-link.txt (internal link to recorded flow).

Short timeline note: If we don't close the two model-serving fixes by Aug 14, probability of an on-time GA drops below 60% (per the risk model).

Thanks — will consolidate and circulate the draft slides at ~3p PT.

— Jonas
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Aug 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR snapshot — launch readiness thermometer & asks

Jonas —

Thanks for the concise snapshot; good work. Quick responses inline: 

- Go/no-go criteria: I reviewed the last tab. PM + CS are aligned on the high-level tradeoffs but we have two clarifying items: retention policy for KV cache in the private deployment (impacts dev/regression cadence) and expected rollback SLA for minor regressions. I marked these as "open" in the sheet with owners (Sarah/Nikhil).
- Risk register: Adding two operational mitigations — temporary throttling policy for heavy ingestion bursts, and a short-lived read-only mode for servicing old contexts during cache rebuilds. I'll attach a short note to the register by EOD.

Open ask for Vivek: we need an explicit statement on whether we can run the multi-region failover (full traffic) on Aug 11 or if that needs to be sliced into staged partials. If you can confirm today, I'll update the timeline and notify Orion.

I'll also pull a short customer-facing summary for the QBR tech slide so we don't overload with internal detail.

— Monica
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Aug 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR snapshot — launch readiness thermometer & asks

On Sat, Aug 4, 2028 at 11:07 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas —
> 
> Thanks for the concise snapshot; good work. Quick responses inline: 
> 
> - Go/no-go criteria: I reviewed the last tab. PM + CS are aligned on the high-level tradeoffs but we have two clarifying items...

All — quick update from infra/eng side: 

- Capacity: I can reallocate 2 x A100s from staging for a 48-hour window starting Aug 10. That should let us do an end-to-end failover exercise (full traffic) with Orion's ingestion pattern. We'll need a rollback window and a day-of playbook (I asked SRE to draft tonight).
- Model-serving fixes: eng triage shows two PRs in flight. ETA for merges + canary is Aug 12. Contingency: if one of those blocks, we can ship with the smaller fix and ramp client-side caching guidance, but that increases support load.
- Multi-region tests: Recommend staged approach — run failover tests with synthetic traffic Aug 10 (staging), limited production failover Aug 12 (off hours), full failover Aug 14. That preserves a safety buffer.

I will send SRE the exact playbook and confirm the resource swap by EOD. Monica — if your CS summary can reflect the staged test plan, that's ideal.

— Vivek
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: sara.nguyen@orionhealth.com, arun.mehta@orionhealth.com
Date: Sat, 04 Aug 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR snapshot — launch readiness thermometer & asks

Team —

Thanks — this is helpful. A few commercial notes for the QBR slide (short bullets I'll include):
- Proposed SLA tiers for Orion: 99.9% with optional 99.95% for a premium (we can present both). Need to confirm the penalty ladder for 99.9 dips; legal prefers a credit-first approach.
- Pricing: early pilot credit we discussed (10% usage credit for first 3 months) is fine; I'll flag this in the deck and ask for formal approval from sales leadership.
- Customer ask: Orion asked to see detailed runbook for multi-region failover during the QBR. Monica — can you provide a one-pager they can take away?

Also looping in Orion (Sara/Arun) so they see the staged test plan Vivek proposed. Sara — does Aug 10 / Aug 12 staging window work on your side?

I'll add these bullet points to the draft slide deck and share with Jonas for the final exec pack.

— Marissa
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
